import { Scene, WebGLRenderer } from 'three';
import { EffectComposer } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
import { frameTime } from '../shared/clean-shared.ts';
import type { Spec } from './clean-browser-spec.ts';

/** Builds the scene once. */
export function init(spec: Spec, renderer: WebGLRenderer): EffectComposer {
  const scene = new Scene();
  scene.name = spec.name;
  return new EffectComposer(renderer);
}

/** Renders one frame as a pure function of the frame number. */
export function render(composer: EffectComposer, frame: number, fps: number): void {
  const seconds = frameTime(frame, fps);
  composer.render(seconds);
}
